_readme: Copy to sources.json and edit. Use a source as <name>:<ref>, e.g. npm run cli -- draft joplin:<noteId>. Commands get the ref as $1 and run in this folder. Keys that start with _ are ignored.

clipboard._readme: Any app: copy the note as Markdown, then draft clipboard: (nothing after the colon). Relative images resolve against baseDir.

joplin._readme: Joplin Web Clipper service (Settings > Web Clipper). Set JOPLIN_TOKEN. No status command, so the status is not saved in Joplin.

folder._readme: Notes kept as files in one folder (Bear/Notable/Zettlr exports, Logseq pages): draft folder:<name without .md>.

web._readme: Module adapter (.ts or .js): a note served as Markdown at a URL (HackMD, gists, an app's share link).
